--- title: "2026-27 NBA contenders" --- ::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"} ## Takeaways - **Built only from players:** each team's current roster (ESPN, November 2026), each player's 2025-26 offense and defense impact from lineups, and his 2025-26 minutes as a rough projection. No 2026-27 results are used. - **Stars count.** Besides overall roster strength, the model weighs each team's best player (lineup-based impact, 1,000+ projected minutes), so Gilgeous-Alexander, Jokić and Wembanyama lift their teams directly. - **Its track record, tested forward in time over 13 seasons:** an average 15% on the eventual champion among all 30 teams (a random pick gives 3%), with the champion in its top three in 8 of 13 seasons. - Odds are a starting point before any games are played, not a prediction of injuries, trades or development. ::: ```{=html}
``` ## Team details *Offense* and *defense*: projected points per 100 possessions vs average, from players' 2025-26 impact. *Top players*: the three with the most projected minutes and their impact. *Arrivals*: players with 1,000+ minutes last season who changed teams. Players who change teams change archetype about 29% of the time, against 17% for those who stay (Step 3), so roles for arrivals are less certain: Dončić kept his role after his trade, Bridges did not.
